reason_for_new_version: V2 required literal FourD context dates to be annual. Source inspection proved that the same FourD contexts are quarter-dated while explicit DateOfStartOfReportingPeriod/DateOfEndOfReportingPeriod facts attached to FourD identify the annual period. Using those explicit period facts is a semantic-rule change and therefore requires a new version.

evidence_standard.primary_raw_evidence: Preserve literal XBRL context dates exactly as filed.
evidence_standard.correction_rule: A proposed semantic-period correction may use explicit period facts attached to the base OneD/FourD table-column groups when deterministic same-filing structure links segment subcontexts to those groups.

all_required: Source hash verifies and filing is point-in-time eligible.
OneD and FourD each contain explicit DateOfStartOfReportingPeriod and DateOfEndOfReportingPeriod facts.
OneD explicit period is quarter-duration and FourD explicit period is annual-duration, with same end date.
OneReportableSegmentRevenue and FourReportableSegmentRevenue groups have identical ordered reportable-segment descriptions.
One segment revenue group reconciles to OneD total SegmentRevenue.
Four segment revenue group reconciles to FourD total SegmentRevenue.
At least one additional One/Four reportable-segment measure family reconciles independently to its OneD/FourD totals.
Original literal subcontext dates are retained and disclosed as conflicting raw metadata.
conditional_rule.proposed_normalization: Assign proposed semantic period of Four reportable-segment facts from the explicit FourD reporting-period facts, while preserving their original literal context dates and recording SOURCE_CONTEXT_DATE_CONFLICT.
